description: This file defines a service class in a Java Spring Boot application for managing User entities. It provides methods to read user information by identification and to list users with pagination.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class for user-related business logic, providing methods to fetch user data.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a user by their identification number and converts the entity to a DTO.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users and converts entities to DTOs.
